integrity: Universal factorization and asymptotics proved analytically; finite \(n=2\) and \(n=3\) distributions exhaustively verified by standalone exact Python enumerators. Independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Common strict student school order, independent uniformly drawn criterion priorities at each school, one seat per school, n students and n schools. Counts weak/intersection-priority stable perfect matchings, not stronger stability notions. No typical-case concentration or correlated-priority guarantees; the classical random-Pareto-maxima factor is credited to earlier work. The seed paper first appeared on 2026-09-11; earlier related partial-priority work is separately credited.
title: Exact multiplicity and uniqueness laws for random intersection-priority school assignments
